name: fx-shuffle
about: Designed on 2026-11-24 and worked by hand before any code (ENGINE.md section 17, 'Designed 2026-11-24: effect 13, a note plays as another sound'; D93). A pattern of eight steps at 120 bpm with a swing of 32 ticks. The lane holds effect 13 on steps 3, 4 and 5, set by edits. While it does, a note of a sound in the effects plays as the sound twelve keys on, round the sixteen: sound 1 as 13, sound 3 as 15, sound 6 as 2, sound 13 as 9. Step 3 holds sound 2 (out of the effects, at probability 80) and sound 6 (at 65): sound 2 plays its own note and sound 6's note plays as sound 2 as well, so each takes its draw, the sound's own first, and one trigger says either passed. Step 4 holds sound 3 at probability 50: an odd step, so its note fires 32 ticks late, as sound 15. Step 5 holds sounds 1 and 13: they sound as 13 and 9, and the trace has them in rising order of the sound that sounds. Steps 1 and 7 hold no effect: sounds 1 and 3 play as themselves. As the third pass begins sound 6 is taken out of the effects: it plays its own note on step 3. As step 5 of the third pass begins the lane's step 5 is emptied: sounds 1 and 13 play as themselves.
